task_title: Add read-only Metaculus prediction market exchange to pmxt
problem_statement:
Add a read-only Metaculus prediction market exchange to pmxt. Currently, pmxt supports Kalshi, Polymarket, Limitless, Probable, Baozi, Myriad, and Opinion exchanges, but has no integration with Metaculus (https://www.metaculus.com).

Read core/ADDING_AN_EXCHANGE.md first — it describes the standard pattern. The Kalshi exchange (core/src/exchanges/kalshi/) is the simplest reference implementation.

The task is to add a new read-only MetaculusExchange that:
1. Fetches binary prediction questions as markets with Yes/No outcomes using their community prediction probability
2. Fetches groups-of-questions as events where each sub-question becomes a separate market
3. Supports optional API token authentication via `Authorization: Token <token>` header
4. Registers the exchange in both the public API exports (core/src/index.ts) and the sidecar server (core/src/server/app.ts) so that /api/metaculus/fetchMarkets and /api/metaculus/fetchEvents work

API reference:
- GET https://www.metaculus.com/api/posts/ returns paginated {count, next, results}
- Binary questions: post.question.type === 'binary', community prediction at post.question.community_prediction.full.yes (0-1)
- Group-of-questions: post.group_of_questions.sub_questions[] — each sub-question becomes a market
- Auth: Authorization: Token <apiToken> header
- Read-only: no trading, websocket, orderbook, or OHLCV needed
problem_statement_variant: Integrate Metaculus as a read-only prediction market exchange following existing exchange patterns. The implementation must include: a MetaculusExchange class extending PredictionMarketExchange, fetchMarkets returning UnifiedMarket[] from binary questions, fetchEvents returning UnifiedEvent[] from group-of-questions, Token-based auth via MetaculusAuth, and server registration in app.ts.
hints: Follow the Kalshi exchange pattern (simplest reference implementation) in core/src/exchanges/kalshi/

Create core/src/exchanges/metaculus/ with: utils.ts (BASE_URL, toMillis, parseNum), auth.ts (MetaculusAuth with Token header), errors.ts (MetaculusErrorMapper), fetcher.ts (raw API data fetching), normalizer.ts (raw→unified mapping), index.ts (MetaculusExchange class)
Metaculus API: GET https://www.metaculus.com/api/posts/ returns paginated {count, next, results}. Each result has question (binary) or group_of_questions (with sub_questions)
Register in core/src/index.ts (export + pmxt dict + short alias) and core/src/server/app.ts (defaultExchanges dict + createExchange case)
Add apiToken to ExchangeCredentials in BaseExchange.ts
No trading, websocket, orderbook, or OHLCV needed — read-only
